# Aquatight Waterproofing

> AS3740-certified waterproofing specialists in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.

Aquatight Waterproofing is the dedicated waterproofing division of Cherry Builds, Melbourne's licensed renovation builder. We specialise in residential and commercial waterproofing across Melbourne's Bayside, Mornington Peninsula, and Eastern Suburbs.

## Services

- [One Stop Service](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/one-stop-service): Complete waterproofing and renovation solution managed end-to-end with Cherry Builds.
- [Waterproofing Bathrooms](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/waterproofing-bathrooms): AS3740-compliant bathroom and wet area waterproofing for new builds and renovations.
- [Rectification Works](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/rectification-works): Diagnosis and repair of failed waterproofing, water ingress, and structural water damage.
- [Renovations](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/renovations): Full bathroom and wet area renovations including waterproofing, tiling, and fit-off.
- [Tiling](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/tiling): All tile formats for wet and dry areas, floor and wall, residential and commercial.
- [Versipave Pod System](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/versipave-pod-system): Industry-leading suspended balcony drainage providing full membrane access without tile removal.
- [Over Existing Hard Surfaces](https://www.aquatightwaterproofing.au/services/over-existing-surfaces): Waterproofing and tiling systems installed directly over existing hard surfaces.
